title: Choosing Activities at the Community Centre · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: The Westside Community Centre opens at 9 a. m. every day. It has many activities for people. Tom likes the cooking class. He goes to the cooking class on Monday. He can make simple cakes, but he cannot make bread. His sister, Lily, likes the art class. She draws pictures on Tuesday. She can draw animals, but she cannot draw people. Their friend, Ben, likes the music class. He sings songs on Wednesday.
